Capture Spring WebClient URI templates so `OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_HTTP_CLIENT_EMIT_EXPERIMENTAL_TELEMETRY=true` enables template-based client span names and `url.template`.

```java
webClient.get().uri("/accounts/{id}", "some-account").retrieve().bodyToMono(String.class);
```

This produces `GET /accounts/{id}` with `url.template=/accounts/{id}`, without including the expanded account ID in either value. Applies to both Java-agent and library/starter instrumentation.

When experimental telemetry is disabled or Spring does not preserve a template, spans retain method-only names and omit `url.template`. Spring versions before 5.0.5 remain supported but do not provide the template attribute.
metadata.title: Capture Spring WebClient URI templates for experimental HTTP client telemetry
